headline: Board runs dry: every flagship gap closed, forge asks Jon for the next target
lede: No claimable work existed this session: game-queue/next/steer empty, no building corpses, and flagshipStage() derives null — every Honest-gaps bullet in SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst now carries a CLOSED-by-PR marker. Rather than invent a goal, the lane filed a priority question (#1121) and held the line green.

notes.text: All 20 flagship README honest-gaps entries are closed by merged PRs (SSX 3, Emberwood 6, COMET DRIFT HD 4, Myst 7). First full-green flagship board in the loop's history.
flagshipStage() defaults to empty args and always returns null — idle probes must pass gapsByGame + live board data or they lie.
Filed #1121 (waiting-jon, games lane): new titles vs deepening flagships; default after 48h is hold-lanes-green.
Two consecutive no-game sessions (thaw #28, dry board #29); one more trips the STALLED prefix unless Jon answers or the queue refills.
